text:
Alex Chen: Quick async — we're moving forward with onboarding mpt-7b-v2 into serving. We have weights uploaded for three quant paths (AWQ, GPTQ, FP8): s3://redwood-models/mpt/mpt-7b-v2/quant/{awq,gptq,fp8}/sha-9f8b7c. Can folks confirm they have the right paths and any immediate blockers?

Priya Nair: I pulled the GPTQ weights and started tokenization checks. Heads up: tokenizer config from the repo sets `pad_token` to null which breaks batch padding for our eval harness (causes offset-by-one on labels). Recommend adding explicit pad/bos/eos in tokenizer_config.json and pinning `add_prefix_space` = false for this model.

Jorge Rivera: Noted. For quant readiness — what calibration set did you use for AWQ? AWQ calibration size will affect perf/accuracy tradeoffs we present to infra.

Maya Patel: I ran quick calibration runs this morning. Summary on the internal eval (subset ~2k prompts):
- AWQ (calib 2k): delta EM +0.6% vs fp16 baseline, latency +3ms
- GPTQ (calib 1k): delta EM -0.2%, latency -6ms (smaller footprint)
- FP8 (no calib step needed here): delta EM +1.1%, but fallback path currently triggers extra kernel selection causing ~7ms tail latency on first token
Logs and plots: https://internal.redwood/bench/mpt-7b-v2/18531

Kai Matsumoto: Thanks Maya. Can you paste the exact serve config you validated? Need to ensure `max_seq_len`, `kv_cache`, and `quant_type` are set correctly before I run the `validate_serving.py` check in CI.

Maya Patel: Serve config I used (snippet):
```yaml
model_name: mpt-7b-v2
max_seq_len: 2048
kv_cache: true
dtype: float16
quant_type: awq  # other options: gptq, fp8
calib_dataset: s3://redwood-calib/mpt-7b-v2/2k.jsonl
```
Note: for GPTQ I changed `quant_type: gptq` and `calib_dataset` to 1k. FP8 uses `quant_type: fp8` and currently ignores calib_dataset.

Alex Chen: perfect. Kai — run the validator with `python tools/validate_serving.py --config serve-config.yaml` (it checks tokenizer mapping, special tokens, and weight dtype/shape). Also the validator will flag if tokenizer special tokens are missing.

Priya Nair: I'm fine signing off on the tokenizer fix once I see the PR that adds `tokenizer_config.json` with: { "pad_token": "<pad>", "bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "add_prefix_space": false }. Will also run a quick tokenization diff stage locally.

Jorge Rivera: For approvals on quantization tradeoffs — we need a short doc with the numbers (perplexity/EM/latency) and recommended default. Maya can you draft that? If AWQ yields better quality, we can default to AWQ but enable GPTQ as a low-cost fallback. Need sign-off from infra for cost estimates.

Maya Patel: I'll draft a one-pager and attach CSV results here by EOD. Preliminary recommendation: default = AWQ (quality), fallback = GPTQ (cost), FP8 = experimental w/ canary due to kernel tail.

Alex Chen: OK — next steps: 1) Priya opens tokenizer PR; 2) Maya posts one-pager + CSV; 3) Kai runs `validate_serving.py` and posts CI output; 4) Jorge coordinates cost estimates with infra. Once those are green, we'll request a canary rollout (small %). I'll ping @deploy-bot to queue canary after approvals.

Priya Nair: SG, opening PR now and tagging @Maya and @Kai.

Jorge Rivera: I'll sync with infra and post numbers tomorrow morning.

Kai Matsumoto: running validator now, will paste output shortly.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for mpt-7b-v2 (quant: awq) — awaiting manual trigger after approvals.

Alex Chen: thanks all. If anyone spots any tokenizer mismatch during CI, call it out here and we'll hold the rollout. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: uploaded results CSV: s3://redwood-bench-results/mpt/mpt-7b-v2/18531/results.csv — one-pager incoming.

Kai Matsumoto: validator results (pass): `tokenizer mappings OK`, `weights shapes OK`, `serve-config schema OK`. No missing special tokens after Priya's PR.

Priya Nair: PR merged.

Jorge Rivera: infra cost estimate posted: AWQ ~1.12x fp16 cost, GPTQ ~0.78x, FP8 ~0.95x but with additional tail latency tax.

Alex Chen: With those numbers I'm going to request canary trigger. @deploy-bot please proceed with canary (5% traffic, 30min monitoring window).

deploy-bot: Canary triggered: mpt-7b-v2-quant-awq -> 5% traffic. Monitoring window 30m. Notifying eng-sre.

Alex Chen: closing the loop — thanks team, will follow up with rollout notes and rollback plan in the release doc.

Priya Nair: nice work.

Jorge Rivera: thanks everyone.

Maya Patel: thanks :rocket:
